samples.xml_description:
<module id="serial2parallel">
    <description>A series-parallel conversion circuit that converts serial input data to parallel output data.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="din_serial">Serial input data.</input>
        <input id="din_valid">Validity signal for input data.</input>
        <output id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data (8 bits wide).</output>
        <output id="dout_valid">Validity signal for the output data.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE" value="2'b00">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="LOADING" value="2'b01">Loading state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="OUTPUTTING" value="2'b10">Outputting state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <reg id="state" width_description="[1:0]">State register.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width_description="[1:0]">Next state register.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]">Counter register.</reg>
        <reg id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data register.</reg>
        <reg id="dout_valid">Valid output signal register.</reg>
        
        // State encoding
        <assign next_state = IDLE;
        <assign next_state = (state == IDLE && din_valid) ? LOADING :
                             (state == LOADING && cnt == 4'd8) ? OUTPUTTING : 
                             (state == OUTPUTTING) ? IDLE : IDLE;
                             
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                state <= next_state;
            end
        end
        
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 4'd0;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    IDLE: begin
                        cnt <= 4'd0;
                    end
                    LOADING: begin
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end
                    default: begin
                        cnt <= 4'd0;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                dout_parallel <= 8'd0;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    LOADING: begin
                        dout_parallel[cnt] <= din_serial;
                    end
                    default: begin
                        dout_parallel <= dout_parallel;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                dout_valid <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    OUTPUTTING: begin
                        dout_valid <= 1'b1;
                    end
                    default: begin
                        dout_valid <= 1'b0;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation></implementation>
    <task></task>
</module>
